note: Wikirate/GRI value (23,000,000 t) is ~660x Cisco's actual Scope 1 scale and is closer to Cisco's fiscal 2021 total (Scope 1+2+3) footprint of ~75.44 Mt CO2e (Scope 3 alone is 99.75% of that per Cisco's own FY21 TCFD/ESG disclosures) -- a wrong-scope pull, not a Scope 1 figure. Cisco does not disclose an exact FY2021 Scope 1 total in a machine-readable form (ESG Hub charts are JS-rendered; the FY21 Purpose Report PDF exceeds automated fetch limits); nearest verifiable disclosed figures (tracenable.com, sourced from Cisco's own CDP/ESG disclosures) are FY2022 34,931 t, FY2023 39,514 t, FY2024 33,683 t -- all consistent with the 'tens of kt' order of magnitude. Corrected value uses the nearest-year (FY2022) figure.

Wikirate/GRI value (4,587,653 t) is ~115x HPE's actual FY2020 Scope 1 of approximately 39.80 million kg CO2e (=39,800 tCO2e) as disclosed in HPE's own FY2020 sustainability reporting (aggregated by DitchCarbon). Same-year match; consistent with 2022-2024 Scope 1 range of 31,908-39,227 t (tracenable.com).

Wikirate/GRI value (12,000 t) is understated by roughly three orders of magnitude for a company whose fleet fuel burn alone is enormous. UPS's own 2009 Corporate Sustainability Report disclosed Scope 1 of 7.5 Mt CO2e (per Transport Topics coverage), and UPS's own recent disclosures (tracenable.com) show Scope 1 of 14.4-15.8 Mt CO2e for FY2022-2024 -- both confirm the 'about 13-14 Mt, mostly fleet fuel' scale. The exact FY2014 figure (UPS 2014 Corporate Sustainability Report, Appendix B 'Statement of Greenhouse Gas Emissions', p.108) could not be extracted by automated tools (large PDF exceeded fetch size/timeout limits); corrected value uses the nearest well-sourced disclosed figure (FY2023, 14,499,000 t) as a same-order-of-magnitude stand-in pending manual verification of the exact FY2014 figure.

Wikirate/GRI value (9.4 t) is near zero for a $17B-revenue diversified industrial manufacturer -- implausible by roughly 5 orders of magnitude. ITW's own CDP Climate Change 2023 response (question C6.1, Gross global Scope 1 emissions) reports 111,371 tCO2e for the 2022 reporting year, matching the pipeline's scope1_year of 2022 exactly.

Wikirate/GRI value (3.11 t) is near zero for a diesel- and blast-intensive open-pit gold miner -- implausible by roughly 6 orders of magnitude. Newmont Corporation's 2021 Climate Report (p.40, 'Estimated greenhouse gas emissions (million tonnes CO2e)' table, GRI 305-1 Total direct (Scope 1) GHG emissions) reports 1.591 million tonnes CO2e for 2019, matching the pipeline's scope1_year of 2019 exactly.
